research_complete_requires: all available frontier resolved; only exact external facts/permissions or owner-policy questions remain

counters.assigned: Unique provider/service hypotheses, not URL/alias counts
counters.processed_current: Actually substantively reconciled by this worker; label inherited_processed separately
counters.fully_verified_current_fresh: All required current primary fields substantively verified this run
counters.fully_verified_retained: Prior actual allowed primary evidence retained with original visit dates; not fresh visits
counters.NEW: Missing eligible real-world identity versus fresh baseline; disclose inherited draft vs current discovery
counters.UPDATE: Unique existing baseline identity with supported field delta; refinements of draft NEW remain NEW
counters.UNRESOLVED: Named missing fact; external vs available unfinished kept separate

source_rules: Official primary branch/team/service/contact; snippets/news/directories leads only. GP Chemo accepted without board credentials. No network-to-branch/radiology-to-radiotherapy/general-surgery-to-cancer inference; common network route allowed with no pin and confirm branch. No auth/CAPTCHA/action-denial/cache/local-output bypass. Unknown lost scope is isolated, not cleared or globalized. No outreach/paid services/trial sweep/UI/editorial change.
full_Russian_report_sections: Inherited vs published vs restored vs actually revisited
National coverage table and primary proof
Named new and corrected providers/cities/services/official URLs
Own available remainder separate from external gaps with URLs/next steps
backup_cadence: Each meaningful block/restriction and <=15min, serialized parent; immutable ready snapshots only
